data: Which system produced the most matches with the reference?

The question asks which system produced the most matches with the reference. From the caption, we know that the shaded cells represent matches between the reference and the one-step system, and the dots represent matches between the reference and the two-step system. By visually inspecting the figure, we can see that there are more shaded cells than dots, indicating that the one-step system produced more matches with the reference compared to the two-step system. Therefore, the one-step system produced the most matches with the reference.
